description: This setting controls Defender's runtime AI Agent network protection that scans network traffic originated from AI Agents. When enabled, Defender inspects the network traffic of agent processes and blocks any traffic that matches a detection for malware/abuse signals before the agent executes it.

options.displayName: AI Agent protection is enabled in block mode - prompts that match a detection are blocked.
options.description: AI Agent protection is enabled in block mode - prompts that match a detection are blocked.

options.displayName: AI Agent protection is enabled in audit mode - prompts that match a detection are logged but not blocked.
options.description: AI Agent protection is enabled in audit mode - prompts that match a detection are logged but not blocked.
